items.description: Compensation for robbery damage (watch and cash)
items.rationale: Indemnified under 2.3.1, 4.2.2, 4.2.3, 4.2.4, 6.3, 7.1.1, 7.1.5, 7.1.7, 7.1.10: both the watch (valuables) and cash (means of payment) were taken by force while away from the insured premises and reported to the police. Sub-limits apply: EUR 2,500 for the watch (per item, no separate schedule), EUR 500 for cash, both within the EUR 5,000 away-from-premises sub-limit. Deductible of EUR 50 applies once per event. Aggregate indemnity: 2,500 + 500 - 50 = 2,950 EUR.
Excluded by 7.1.8(b): carriage, shipping, delivery and comparable charges are not indemnified, even if related to the claim or property.
